offence: Person given a notice under s.6(2) fails to comply with any requirement in the notice
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no Act-wide police arrest-without-warrant clause found; fine only — CPC default for other laws). s.7(1)(a) except a continuing offence is compoundable (S 602/2026)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000; continuing offence: further fine not exceeding $500 for every day or part of a day after conviction (s.7(6)). Defence: took all reasonable steps to comply (s.7(2))

offence: Alters, damages or destroys a document that must be given under a s.6(2) notice; or gives information or a document that is false or misleading in a material particular (or by omission)
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no Act-wide police arrest-without-warrant clause found; fine only — CPC default). Compoundable under S 602/2026
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000 (s.7(7)). Defences in s.7(3)–(5)

offence: Knowingly gives information or a document in response to a s.6(2) notice that is false or misleading in a material particular (or by omission)
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no Act-wide police arrest-without-warrant clause found; fine only — CPC default)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000; second or subsequent: fine not exceeding $20,000 (s.7(8))

offence: Fails to comply with a racial content restraining order made against the person (including as confirmed, varied or extended)
arrestText: May arrest without warrant on subsequent conviction (max 3 years — CPC default). First conviction max 2 years is under 3 years so CPC default would be non-arrestable; no Act-wide arrest clause found — check facts before relying on first-conviction default
bailText: First: bailable (max 2 years). Subsequent: not bailable (max 3 years) — CPC default for other laws
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years or both; second or subsequent: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both

offence: With intent to deceive, withholds from a designated entity information about donations, or knowingly gives the entity information about donations that is false or misleading in a material particular (identity of donor / person on whose behalf donation made / amount or value)
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no Act-wide police arrest-without-warrant clause found; fine only — CPC default for other laws)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000; second or subsequent conviction: fine not exceeding $20,000 (s.21(3))

offence: Removal direction against a designated entity not complied with (entity and each governing-body member while non-compliance continues)
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no Act-wide police arrest-without-warrant clause found; fine only — CPC default)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000; continuing offence: further fine of $1,000 for every day or part of a day after conviction (s.26(5)). Defences: all reasonable steps (s.26(3)/(4))

offence: Foreign influence restraining order against a designated entity not complied with (entity and each governing-body member when / while non-compliance)
arrestText: First conviction max 2 years — CPC default non-arrestable; subsequent max 3 years — arrestable. No Act-wide arrest clause found
bailText: First: bailable (max 2 years). Subsequent: not bailable (max 3 years) — CPC default
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 2 years or both; second or subsequent: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both (s.29(5))

offence: Facilitating a foreign donation prohibited by a foreign influence restraining order
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no Act-wide police arrest-without-warrant clause found; fine only — CPC default)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000; second or subsequent: fine not exceeding $20,000 (s.30(2))

offence: Urging force or violence against a person or a group distinguished by race, or urging another to engage in conduct intending force or violence, because of a belief about race (s.39(1)/(2)/(3))
arrestText: May arrest without warrant (no Act-specific general arrest clause found — CPC default for other laws, max 10 years)
punishment: Fine or imprisonment not exceeding 10 years or both (s.39(7)). Prosecution only with Public Prosecutor's consent (s.44)

offence: Inciting enmity, hatred, ill-will or hostility against, or contempt for or ridicule of, a group distinguished by race; or insulting, vilifying, denigrating, threatening or abusing another person on the basis of race (s.40(1)/(2))
arrestText: May arrest without warrant (no Act-specific general arrest clause found — CPC default for other laws, max 5 years)
punishment: Fine or imprisonment not exceeding 5 years or both (s.40(7)). s.40(2) is compoundable by the person insulted (CPC Fourth Schedule Part 3A item 56A). Prosecution only with Public Prosecutor's consent (s.44)

offence: Person summoned by the Minister for a removal-direction appeal fails to comply with the summons, or produces a document that contains a false or misleading material particular or is misleading by omission
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no Act-wide police arrest-without-warrant clause found; fine only — CPC default for other laws) . Compoundable under S 602/2026 reg 2(c)
punishment: Fail to comply with summons: fine not exceeding $2,000. False or misleading document: fine not exceeding $5,000 (S 600/2026 Schedule para 13(3))

offence: Responsible officer of a designated entity when the entity fails to submit a donations report (r.9), foreign affiliations report (r.16), or key management report (r.22 or 23) as required (strict liability)
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no Act-wide police arrest-without-warrant clause found; fine only — CPC default for other laws) . Prescribed for MRHA s.22
punishment: Fine not exceeding $2,000; continuing offence: further fine not exceeding $200 for every day or part of a day after conviction (S 600/2026 r.26(3)). Defence: all reasonable steps and due diligence (r.26(4))

offence: Responsible officer of a designated entity that fails to give the competent authority the written notice of non-compliance required under regulation 24 by the end of the specified period (strict liability)
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no Act-wide police arrest-without-warrant clause found; fine only — CPC default for other laws) . Prescribed for MRHA s.22
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000; continuing offence: further fine not exceeding $500 for every day or part of a day after conviction (S 600/2026 r.27(3)). Defence: all reasonable steps and due diligence (r.27(4))

offence: Responsible officer knowingly states or includes in a donations, foreign affiliations or key management report a matter that is false or misleading in a material particular, or omits a matter without which the report is false or misleading
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no Act-wide police arrest-without-warrant clause found; fine only — CPC default for other laws) . Prescribed for MRHA s.22
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000; second or subsequent conviction: fine not exceeding $20,000 (S 600/2026 r.28(2))

offence: Responsible officer of a designated entity when a donations, foreign affiliations or key management report contains a false or misleading material particular, or omits a matter without which the report is false or misleading (strict liability)
arrestText: May not arrest without warrant (no Act-wide police arrest-without-warrant clause found; fine only — CPC default for other laws) . Prescribed for MRHA s.22
punishment: Fine not exceeding $5,000 (S 600/2026 r.29(3)). Defence: all reasonable steps and due diligence (r.29(4))
